performance_case.causal_mechanism: Weekly regulator-aggregated CME Bitcoin trader positioning may describe a slower institutional risk state distinct from spot price, spot order flow, carry and shock labels, but only a release-time-safe sealed source can support a later test without observation-date leakage.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This dispatch may freeze only the exact TFF Futures Only source identity, official release and receipt timeline, deterministic raw-byte and row sealing, fail-closed states, one-clock architecture and earliest lawful later decision. It cannot retrieve a report, choose a field or formula, define a factor or strategy, implement or activate capture, register research, open OOS, change canonical state or schedule, or perform any Trading action.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future independently preregistered spot-only admission mechanism might reduce adverse exposure only if a separately sealed COT factor later passes predictive breadth and equal-capital drawdown gates; all such value remains MISSING_PROOF.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A weekly source adds at least a multi-day information lag and possible missing-contract weeks, but its static official format and low capture burden may provide a distinct slow state without diverting resources to continuous feeds. Freezing availability and absence rules now prevents hidden look-ahead and repeated implementation churn.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The design itself cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Its value is making one low-cost, causally distinct source implementable and falsifiable without creating a second clock, while closing the route if official identity or point-in-time semantics cannot be made deterministic.
